_comment: Pod name tokens -> the 5G role that pod should have (role_fusion.py).
then its workload and pod name, are split into lower-case words at every
non-letter/digit and trailing digits are dropped (open5gs-amf-0 -> open5gs, amf).
The first candidate with a matching token decides; hints are tried in order.
'also' lists further engine roles that agree with the hint (a CU is also
an E2 node; an SMF seen only through PFCP association is a PFCP_NODE).
